description: This file declares the WindowsSystemProxyResolutionService class, which manages proxy resolution on Windows using WinHttp APIs, including methods for creating instances, resolving proxies, reporting success, and managing proxy cache.

classes.name: WindowsSystemProxyResolutionService
classes.description: Manages Windows proxy resolution using WinHttp APIs, including proxy request handling, caching bad proxies, and logging.

methods.name: IsSupported
methods.description: Checks if Windows proxy resolution is supported on the current system.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates an instance of WindowsSystemProxyResolutionService if dependencies are satisfied.

methods.name: ResolveProxy
methods.description: Resolves the proxy for a given URL using WinHttp APIs.

methods.name: SetProxyDelegate
methods.description: Sets a delegate for proxy events.

methods.name: MarkProxiesAsBadUntil
methods.description: Marks certain proxies as bad until a specified time.

methods.name: ClearBadProxiesCache
methods.description: Clears the cache of bad proxies.

methods.name: proxy_retry_info
methods.description: Accesses the map of proxies with retry information.

methods.name: GetProxyNetLogValues
methods.description: Retrieves logging information related to proxy resolution.

methods.name: CastToConfiguredProxyResolutionService
methods.description: Attempts to cast to a configured proxy resolution service.
